payload.rationale: Fix hard-gate failures with minimal edits: (1) close critical risk K8 by adding mitigation and acceptance text; (2) restore evidence traceability by correcting DEC6 artifact_ref to the declared capsule; (3) satisfy id_integrity by replacing architecture option free-text risk strings with existing risk_register IDs (or empty lists where no matching IDs exist).

value.text: Implement a mandatory build-time privacy gate: support an explicit, configurable marker to exclude notes from emission AND from search indexing; generate a human-readable exclusion report; provide warn vs fail (strict) modes; ensure excluded notes are not present anywhere in output artifacts (HTML, JSON, manifests).

patch.value: Given a fixture where at least one note is marked private/non-publishable, the build output MUST contain no rendered page for that note and the search index MUST NOT include its title/body; the build MUST emit a clear report listing excluded notes; in strict mode the build MUST fail if any private-marked note would otherwise be emitted/indexed.
